summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC filed a Form 6-K on 10 September 2026 attaching a press release announcing a collaboration agreement with Oritain Global Limited, a forensic origin-verification firm, to build an inaugural tungsten provenance database covering the company's Tempiute and Pilot Mountain projects in Nevada. No securities, ownership stakes, prices, premiums, board recommendations, advisors, or regulatory clocks are disclosed; terms are not financially specified. The item is an ordinary commercial/technical collaboration, not a special situation, so the filing is classified None; watch for operational milestones rather than deal or capital-structure catalysts.
